payload.summary: COUNTER (codex gpt, quoted — ran outside nahel dispatch, no run dir). Verdict AGREE with a sharpening. Attack: 'The human explicitly named only Player, and Banker total placement was previously approved; changing Banker risks reopening settled work while he is AFK.' Verdict: 'Mirror both seats through seat-driven CSS. Player must right-align and reverse its card row; Banker remains left-aligned, so each third card is outboard and each inner edge seats identically off .hand-divider.' Why: 'The fixed destination explicitly requires both hands to be seated against the centre line. Leaving Banker flush-left preserves an accidental layout and puts its appended third card inboard.' The sharpening matters: mirroring does NOT mean re-aligning the banker's cards — the banker stays left-aligned in its column and only its card ORDER and header order change, so the approved hand-total work is not re-opened, only mirrored in reading direction.
